INFINITE PLAY · GLOBAL ALBUM SHOP

Thousands of playable orchestra variants. One clear shop.

A searchable, configurable product shelf for cafés, hotels, wellness, work, dining, culture and more. Match the operating context first; then shape the daypart, feeling, listening reference and playable ensemble. Every card is a starting design—not a claim of universal preference or guaranteed sales.

Mekân, saat, duygu, kıta/bölge, tonik, 12-TET mod ve türü seçin; 42 tasarım tabanından on-demand mini HTML ve enstrüman posterleri oluşturun. 30.240 temel tonik×mod×tür varyantı; özel çalgı kombinasyonları bunun dışında. Ürün adları küresel sunum için İngilizce tutulmuştur.

42DESIGN STARTERS
30,240ON-DEMAND VARIANTS · 42 × 12 × 6 × 10
Album-varyant motoru: 12 tonal center × 6 supported engine modes × 10 generation styles are built on demand from 42 curated place/time/ensemble starters = 30,240 base parameter combinations, generated on demand. Custom instrument combinations multiply the shop further but are not included in that count. These are settings variants—not 30,240 pre-rendered, individually listened-to or quality-certified albums.
32 designs

Compatibility engine: venue + daypart + emotional intention + reference-color + modal lens + playable voice banks. This is an explainable rule-based matcher and mix-starting-level heuristic, not a trained recommendation model or acoustically calibrated auto-mixer. Fader-seed formula: mood baseline + voice-role offsets (lead +12, chordal/plucked +6, bass foundation −8, bright/transient color −14) −2 per voice beyond four; values are source-fader units, not dB or room loudness. It does not automate EQ, panning, stereo width or acoustic correction. The labeled regional and makam fields are cultural listening references; they do not certify authenticity, maqam seyir, tuning, or local acceptance. Standalone mini exports apply selected voice banks, BPM window, heuristic fader values, a selected tonic (when chosen), supported 12-TET mode and supported genreStyle. Venue, mood and cultural tags travel as product context; mood shifts only the heuristic fader baseline. The existing rule-based generator applies genre/mode settings, but outputs are not field-tested or culture-certified. Test in the real room with local listeners before commercial use.

Research basis, market signals & limits

We use evidence to guide the product design process, not to claim a “perfect” playlist. Hospitality research finds that music effects depend on design, context, congruence and listener preference; a restaurant field experiment reports context-specific tempo effects, while the broader literature does not support a universal BPM formula. IFPI’s 2026 report describes 2025 recorded-music revenue and streaming-market growth—including MENA—but those market figures are not sales data for background-music mini-orchestras.

  • Trompeta et al. (2022), meta-analysis of music in tourism and hospitality · context, congruence and preferences matter.
  • Malcman et al. (2024), restaurant field experiment · a single-site experiment; not a universal tempo rule.
  • IFPI Global Music Report 2026 · recorded-music market context, not demand proof for this product.
  • Bai et al. (2024), soundscape and tourism experience · place-specific soundscape is worth evaluating locally.
  • Karaosmanoğlu et al. (2023), computational analysis of Turkish makam music · scale matching alone misses melodic progression and seyir.

Commercial honesty: “Trending”, “most needed”, demand, retention and sales rank require platform analytics or venue pilots. This catalog is a launch assortment and testable hypothesis. The generator’s 12-tone mode must not be marketed as authentic makam performance.

“Müzik zaten var; biz sadece duyarız, sahip olamayız.”∞ · HER ESER YENİ BİR KEŞİF

Doğa dokuları dış kayıtsız, enstrüman örneklerinin filtre ve zarf benzetimleridir; gerçek nefes, yaprak, su veya kuş kaydı değildir. Serbest akış ölçüsüz değil; notaya yazılmış seyrek olaylar ve ortak tempo haritasıdır. Kemane-esintili ses gerçek kabak kemane kaydı değildir: CC0 erhu örnekleri pesleştirilmiştir. Klarnet, shakuhachi ve dünya havuzundaki yeni çalgılar örnek tabanlıdır. Yeni FluidR3_GM örnekleri: Frank Wen ve katkıda bulunanlar; MIDI.js için dönüştürme: Benjamin Gleitzman; CC BY 3.0, https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/3.0/us/ . Kemane yaklaşımı: sfzinstruments AliExpress Erhu, CC0 1.0, https://github.com/sfzinstruments/aliexpress-erhu . Otomatik şef 12 tonal merkezi kullanır; ardışık merkezler dairesel olarak 1–3 yarım ses uzaklıktadır. Majör, doğal minör, Doryen, Lidyen ve Miksolidyen seçilebilir; Hicaz benzetimi 12 eşit sesli bir dizidir, gerçek makam değildir. Her yeni eser tarayıcıda rastgele seed ve yerel arşivle üretilir. Ayrı tarayıcılar farklı eserler üretebilir; evrensel benzersizlik garanti edilmez. Ölçerler dijitaldir, kulaktaki ses basıncını göstermez. Bebeklerde çok düşük ses, uzak hoparlör ve kısa süre kullanın.

SOUND LAB / CONTROL DESK

Mixer & composition

Instrument checkbox = mute/unmute now and include/exclude from the next score. Gain sliders run from 0% (silent) to their labelled maximum and apply live.

High gain may distort sound or damage hearing and speakers. Start low.

INFINITE · AUTO GENRE POOL

With Auto off, the first checked influence is fixed; otherwise one is chosen for each new work. Profiles influence tempo and mode; they are design references, not claims of authentic genre performance. Contemporary Western piano + bass-guitar requirements remain in force.

INFINITE DRUM BOX · LIVE ONLY
Recorded acoustic kit · CC0 sample library · short soft fills bridge rhythmic gaps · live only; not in MusicXML.
WORLD INSTRUMENT POOL · GM SAMPLES

With the conductor on, checked instruments form the permitted pool. A subset is selected for each new work. The 28 added voices use GM samples, not regional performance recordings.

KEYBOARDS · 2
PLUCKED STRINGS · 7
BOWED STRING · 1
WOODWINDS · 9
BRASS · 3
FREE REED · 1
PITCHED PERCUSSION · 4
FOUNDATION VOICES · SAMPLES + SYNTHESIS

GM tom and taiko samples suggest skin-drum strokes; woodblock and agogo provide wood and metal colors. They are not recordings of bendir, def or darbuka. The written bass line uses a standard acoustic bass guitar sample and octave-transposing notation. The acoustic bass stays near center, while melodic voices and textures follow gentle 3D paths.

SOLO VOICE · LEGACY SAMPLE (NEW WORKS OFF)

One recorded voice using three vowel banks; not a choir and not words. The sample author released these recordings under CC0. Pitch-shifting and looping remain approximations.

SOUND · EQ · COMPOSITION
Fixed EQ · shared stereo

Measured pre-EQ spectrum drives slow cuts up to 3 dB; manual EQ remains separate. Shared stereo sends the same equal-power L/R mix to headphones and speakers; placement and frequency perception still vary by headphones, speakers, room, fit and hearing. HRTF is an optional headphone-only rendering. This chain is not a hearing-safety guarantee.

✓ Selections apply to the next work · silent introduction optional
DNA · CONTROL · ARCHIVE

Bendir, def and darbuka-inspired strokes use GM tom and taiko samples, not recordings of those instruments. The bass steps use sampled acoustic bass, not a synthesized oscillator. Pitch follows the written chord; a simple lead-family and density rule adjusts texture. This is not acoustic timbre matching. Selections apply to the next composition.

LOADING ARCHIVERule-based conductor and local counters do not measure listeners or hearing safety. Back up your DNA.

LEGO score builder

Start a composition in the orchestra first. Add measure ranges from the current work in any order, then select the voices to keep. The score clips notes at segment boundaries; this is an arrangement, not automatic musical mastering.

No work loaded
Voices in current work

Unselected voices are excluded. Cello arco and pizzicato share one score staff.

The score ZIP contains MusicXML, arrangement JSON, an English MuseScore guide and license notices. Use ZIP with WAV for a complete combined download.

Mini orchestra builder

Select one or more existing orchestra voices. The builder copies only selected sample banks into a self-contained HTML. Global voices include GM approximations; Erhu uses CC0 recordings by D. Smolken; đàn tranh, balafon and ocarina use CC0 recordings from VCSL / Versilian Studios.

Optional foundation layers

The mini shows playback, master volume, tempo, per-instrument volume + three-band EQ and MusicXML. The score-rendering, PDF and ZIP libraries are omitted; internal generator controls remain hidden. Presets are locked to the selected voices. Review third-party notices before distribution.

Auto Mini Lab

Rank contemporary Western mini-ensembles with required piano and bass guitar, choose a hopeful, calm or warm flowing design, and prepare separate product ZIPs. Covers are generated as editable SVGs; each mini HTML exposes master volume, tempo and MusicXML.

Compatibility method

The score uses declared range coverage, family diversity, register overlap and sustaining/plucked contrast. It does not analyse recordings, prove harmony or validate a musical culture. Every exported mini retains volume and EQ controls.

Each product contains a selected-samples HTML, SVG cover, printable A3 SVG poster, example MusicXML, technical manifest, guide and license notices. Examples are generated and structurally checked one by one.

The current Studio uses a reduced contemporary Western pool. Every piece includes piano and an acoustic bass-guitar part; the selectable mini uses one or two additional color instruments. Generated music and cultural authenticity require human review. Large batches require substantial time and storage; payments and rights clearance are not included.

Audio WAV

Single-work launch video

Create a short animated product presentation using the current work’s rendered audio and actual instrumentation. Video rendering pauses orchestra playback and records in real time; keep this tab visible until it finishes. Local WebM download only, no upload.

The first seconds of the actual work are used. Any silent introduction stays silent. Audio uses the simplified offline mix, not necessarily the live mix. If the work is shorter than the chosen duration, the clip is shortened.
